text: Every day, we get news from many places. We can read a newspaper, watch television, listen to the radio, or check the internet for the latest news. A journalist works hard to report new stories about the world. They write an article about important events and give it a clear headline so people want to read it. Sometimes a journalist does an interview with a person to get more information. Good news should show facts, not just an opinion. A fact is something that is true, but an opinion is what a person thinks or feels. When something important happens, a journalist will announce it quickly. Newspapers publish new stories every day, and TV channels broadcast the news every evening. The internet gives us a fast update about events happening around the world, right now. It is important to check different sources before you believe a story, because not all information online is true. Reading the news helps us understand what is happening in our country and around the world, and it helps us talk about current events with other people.
